subheading: Things I've built to think through problems I found interesting.

items.title: VyasaGraph
items.subtitle: Mahabharata Knowledge Graph & RAG Chatbot
items.blurb: A knowledge graph over the 1.8M-word Mahabharata corpus — 228 characters and 315 relationships sourced from three independent pipelines — with a graph-augmented RAG chatbot grounded in both structured facts and source text.
details: Built the graph from three independent sources — spaCy dependency-parsed attestations from the original text, a structured CSV dataset, and Wikidata SPARQL queries — with human review and deduplication across all of them.

Implemented a graph-augmented RAG pipeline combining Neo4j Cypher queries with ChromaDB semantic search (960 embedded chunks), served through a FastAPI streaming backend and a React chat interface with real-time citation display.

items.title: ParetoFolio
items.subtitle: Portfolio Optimization Engine
items.blurb: A multi-objective portfolio optimizer implementing NSGA-II from scratch, serving Pareto-optimal portfolios across 75 US equities through an interactive efficient frontier.
details: Built a responsive React 19 frontend with interactive data visualization and a typed FastAPI backend exposing a RESTful optimization API.

Implemented NSGA-II from scratch — SBX crossover, polynomial mutation, tournament selection, and crowding distance — producing Pareto-optimal portfolios with a Sharpe-ranked table and interactive efficient frontier.

items.title: SportsTV Streaming Data Warehouse
items.subtitle: ETL Pipeline & Dimensional Model
items.blurb: A Kimball-style star schema and idempotent ETL pipeline achieving 99%+ match rate across 2M+ streaming transactions from heterogeneous sources.
details: Engineered a bulk-batched, idempotent ETL pipeline with surrogate-key resolution and partition pruning, achieving a 99%+ match rate across 2M+ streaming transactions.
Modeled a Kimball-style star schema with five conformed dimensions and a RANGE-partitioned fact table, driving a fully automated BI report from live SQL queries.

items.title: Gojo Satoru Hand-Tracking VFX
items.subtitle: Real-Time Gesture-Driven Visual Effects
items.blurb: A real-time, markerless VFX engine that overlays anime-inspired cursed-energy effects onto a live webcam feed, driven entirely by hand gestures — no green screen or controller.
details: Tracks both hands at 21 landmarks each, classifies five distinct gestures, and maps each to a different effect: hand-following auras, energy orbs, a charged beam between the palms, and a full-frame Domain Expansion with background segmentation.

Implemented a 200-particle physics system, additive glow compositing, and confidence-mask alpha blending, then ported the desktop OpenCV app to the browser via a per-session WebRTC processor served through Streamlit.

items.title: Java Calendar Application
items.subtitle: MVC Calendar with Recurring Events
items.blurb: A calendar application in Java with MVC architecture supporting recurring event series, timezone handling, and multiple views, built with rigorous mutation-tested coverage.
details: Built with extensive use of design patterns — Builder, Command, Strategy, Visitor, Decorator, and Factory Method — with a full Swing GUI.
Validated the test suite with JUnit and PIT mutation testing, achieving high mutation kill rates that proved effectiveness beyond simple line coverage.
